_comment: Generated by Tools/terrain/walkmap.mjs from the heightmap, layout and dressing. Roaming wildlife's map (WRWildlife): cell cm, origin = the world position of cell 0,0's corner, rows[y][x]: ~ sea, x nobody (arenas, caves), # steep or hazard (flyers cross it), g ground, f flat open ground (feeding), w ground by the shore. bands (metres from the ridge at X = 0) and campGap (metres) keep each kind where spawns.mjs put it. Grown to cover Storm peaks by Tools/terrain/storm_walk.mjs (cells north of the island's edge come from Art/Terrain/storm_height.r16; storm_peaks creatures keep to them, island creatures to the island).
